decisions: Do not add a screen or alter the production navigation: switch only the in-memory data source beneath the app's real pages.
Use fictional metadata, covers, progress, favorites, and lists; all demonstration mutations remain process-local.
Block scans and real-library mutations while the exhibition dataset is active; process restart restores the original dataset.
planned_doc_changes: Add R48 and the exhibition-mode contract.
Register data substitution and mode behavior in the UI shell module metadata.
implementation_changes: Added the five-tap hidden trigger while retaining the standard Melaan navigation and screen routing.
Added in-memory dataset overrides to the shared snapshot, archive, progress, collections, bookmarks, and per-comic reader settings.
Added generated sample covers/pages and prevented scans or demo actions from touching persisted manga data.
validation_results: Debug APK build succeeded and installed to connected Android device.
ADB screenshot shows the standard Melaan home screen, navigation, and fictional catalog; no personal wallpaper or manga metadata is visible.
Document index and schema validation passed.
unverified: Visual device verification of every tab and reader interactions with generated pages.
sync_status: implementation, debug build, installation, and home-screen screenshot verified
